about: Owner D39: the aerial view of the town behind the loading screen. tools/review/loading_aerial.luau writes the scene (the town, attractions, sky lift, backdrop, and the trees and woods as their uploaded FBX art); tools/review/render.py renders this view. Warm late-afternoon light, a soft sun (3 degrees), a little distance haze.

views.desc: From high over the south fields (about 35 degrees down) north across the town grid and the river to the beach and the sea.
